_comment: Camera moves offered by capcut_add_camera_move: names and descriptions for both the backend (camera_moves.py, which implements each one) and the MCP server. Presets marked cover zoom as much as their rotation and offsets need so no canvas edge shows; those marked fill shrink the image on purpose and get a blurred background where CapCut allows it.

keyframes.name: punch_in
keyframes.description: cut in closer for the range, then cut back

keyframes.name: zoom_in_out
keyframes.description: smoothly move in, hold, ease back out

keyframes.name: push_in
keyframes.description: slow continuous push in (Ken Burns)

keyframes.name: pull_out
keyframes.description: start close, slowly pull back

keyframes.name: punch
keyframes.description: impact hit: fast zoom kick that settles (~0.5 s)

keyframes.name: zoom_bounce
keyframes.description: quick zoom in with a small elastic overshoot

keyframes.name: pan_left
keyframes.description: camera pans left

keyframes.name: pan_right

keyframes.name: tilt_up
